easy.def: To stay up and not fall over.
easy.example: I can balance on one foot.

more.def: To keep yourself or an object steady so it does not tip or fall.
more.example: The gymnast balanced on the narrow beam without wobbling.

easy.def: A small animal that flies at night.
easy.example: A bat flew out of the cave.

more.def: A small furry animal with wings that sleeps in the day and flies at night.
more.example: The bat hung upside down from the roof of the cave.

easy.def: A stick you use to hit a ball.
easy.example: She hit the ball with her bat.

more.def: A wooden or metal stick used to hit the ball in games like baseball and cricket.
more.example: He swung the bat and sent the ball over the fence.

easy.def: To hit something, like a ball.
easy.example: The cat likes to bat the toy.

more.def: To hit at something with a bat or with your hand or paw.
more.example: The kitten batted the string back and forth.

easy.def: To use something that is not yours and then give it back.
easy.example: Can I borrow your red crayon?

more.def: To take and use something that belongs to someone else, planning to return it.
more.example: She borrowed three books from the library and returned them on Friday.

easy.example: The brave girl went down the big slide.

more.def: Willing to do something hard or scary even when you feel afraid.
more.example: It was brave of him to speak in front of the whole school.
